name: The Heron & Hops
tagline: Proper pints, Sunday roasts and a beer garden by the river.
intro: A freehouse with six rotating cask ales, a log fire in winter, and a kitchen cooking pub classics with care.
notice: Now booking Christmas parties. Set menu from £32 a head.

items.name: Heron burger
items.desc: Aged beef, smoked cheddar, bacon jam, fries

dietaryNote: V vegetarian · VG vegan · GF gluten-free ingredients. Full allergen information is available from the bar. Please ask before ordering.

about.heading: A proper local, done properly
body: The Heron has been a pub since the 1800s. We took it on to keep it what it should be: somewhere you can bring your parents, your dog or your five-a-side team.
Six cask lines rotate weekly, with at least two from Cambridgeshire breweries.

events.title: Quiz night
events.desc: £2 a head, teams of up to 6. Bar tab for the winners.

events.title: Folk session
events.desc: Bring an instrument or just a pint.

events.title: Christmas jumper party
events.desc: Free mulled wine for the best (worst) jumper.

privateHire.heading: Private hire: the Boathouse Room
privateHire.body: Our upstairs room seats 30 or holds 50 standing, with its own bar and river views. It’s ideal for birthdays, wakes, work dos and christenings. There’s no hire fee from Sunday to Thursday, with a minimum spend at weekends.

faqs.a: In the bar and garden, yes. Not in the dining room.
Six Nations and major tournaments only, with the sound low.
A small car park, plus cycle racks out front.
